title: Pandolfi going to Los Alamos to talk to a live alien

tellings.quote: meets and he says, "Uh I'm going to Los Alamos uh this week. I'm gonna talk to I'm talking to Live Elliot."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron told podcast host Jesse Michels a story about Ron Pandolfi, a man Cameron describes as a senior figure in the government's handling of UFOs. Cameron says that around 1991, at a meeting that also involved Dan Smith and John Alexander, Pandolfi said he was going that week to Los Alamos, a government science lab in New Mexico, to talk to a live alien. If true, it would mean the government held a living being from elsewhere.
